_comment: Approved tour cards used by the Daniela Concierge (recommendation cards, tour context for WhatsApp). Each entry must match the approved catalog snapshot (knowledge/concierge/versions/public-tour-catalog/<id>/): same id, title and public path, and a Portuguese summary that is a verbatim excerpt of the snapshot description. A test enforces it. To add a published tour: see docs/architecture/daniela-catalog-update-procedure.md.
